$comment: The email templates every organisation starts with (ADR-12, M2-BE-10), in the template document format, English and Serbian. Seeded by the production seed, by seed:e2e and by the e2e factories; an admin edits them in 0.4.0. Placeholders are objects, never text; a secure link is the address of a link node.
